title: Jr Industrial Designer
note: Junior appliance industrial design role in Brazil. It asks for intermediate English and a portfolio, and applications close November 30.

facts.duties: Work through the whole design process from user observation to launch plan. Analyze market and user information, set design requirements, lead concept creation with sketches, 3D models and renderings, apply brand visual language, present to peers, suppliers and business teams, and take part in Lean projects.
facts.requirements: Degree in design or engineering. Strong CAD and visualization skills (Alias, Rhino, CATIA V5, Illustrator, Photoshop, KeyShot), sketching and presentation skills, intermediate English, and a required portfolio or personal website. No years of experience stated.
facts.apply: Apply online through the Electrolux Group Workday careers site with a CV and portfolio by 2026-11-30.
